description: Read the composition shared by your After Effects panel: its settings, every layer with its key (L1, L2…), in and out frames, transform and expressions, the project items, output templates and the render queue, plus a revision. Inspect readAt for freshness. Right after an edit it waits a few seconds for the composition after that edit and never returns the one from before it: an error asks you to read again, and editRunning means the edit has not finished. Layer keys can shift after every edit, so always read again after done. No footage bytes. First call aftereffects_list_connections to get the deviceId of your connected After Effects panel.

deviceId.description: The id of your connected After Effects panel, from aftereffects_list_connections.

name: aftereffects_read_project
title: Read After Effects Project
